runs: /bin/zsh -lc 'git -C /Users/xiaorongli/Dev/growth remote -v && gh pr list --repo "$(git -C /Users/xiaorongli/Dev/growth remote get-url origin)" --state open --limit 200 --json number,title,isDraft,url,createdAt,updatedAt'
/bin/zsh -lc 'git remote -v && git rev-parse --show-toplevel && gh repo view --json nameWithOwner,url'

/bin/zsh -lc 'ls -la /Users/xiaorongli/Dev/flywheel && git -C /Users/xiaorongli/Dev/flywheel remote -v && gh pr list --repo "$(git -C /Users/xiaorongli/Dev/flywheel remote get-url origin)" --state open --limit 200 --json number,title,isDraft,url,createdAt,updatedAt'
/bin/zsh -lc "gh pr list --repo xrliAnnie/flywheel --state open --limit 500 --json number,isDraft | jq '{total:length, ready:map(select(.isDraft|not))|length, drafts:map(select(.isDraft))|length}'"
